name: photographic-look
description: PHOTO-FILL: the Photographic switch ships in a production-shaped build (the flag defaults ON so the CONTROL exists), the LOOK is off until toggled, and toggling it never writes the user's Lights switch. Simple mode only — Simple is the default and the harder case (a `pro`-tier flag would be forced off there); presence in BOTH modes is pinned by the unit test in `src/scene/photographicFill.test.ts`.
